scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm -C backend run dev" "npm -C frontend run dev"
scripts.backend:check: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.js backend | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\node_modules\\' } | ForEach-Object { node --check $_.FullName }"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run backend:check && npm run frontend:build
